cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Apologize to Reality
cards.instruction: Get someone to apologize to an object, rule, place, or idea for violating its impossible expectations.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before your caretaker interview, apologise to that chair. You sat without its consent.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Silence isn't permission. Address the chair, please, not me.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Sorry, chair. I'll stand for the interview.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: No, now you're abandoning it. Apologise for that before you stand. I need to see you resolve a complaint, not walk away from one.

cardFidelity.evidence: A3 corrects the apology addressee and A5 the offered remedy, making expert caretaker assessment pursue apologies to an object with impossible consent expectations.

heightening.evidence: A5 turns B4 practical remedy into a new duty to apologize while tying it to the job's care standard.
